contract: Road user a is decelerating at an observation: its forward speed is falling. Measured as its acceleration along its heading (kin.accel_longitudinal, m/s², signed) at or below the negative of the deceleration tolerance, the magnitude below which a sampled acceleration counts as none, while a is not backing (drv.motion.backing with the speed tolerance does not hold), since for a backing road user a negative value is a gain of speed. Not a stand-in for its speed or for the brake lamp: a lit lamp without a deceleration is no deceleration.

params.name: decel_tolerance
params.meaning: the deceleration magnitude below which a sampled acceleration counts as none

params.name: speed_tolerance
params.meaning: the speed below which a sampled motion along the heading counts as none

elements.span: its acceleration along its heading (kin.accel_longitudinal, m/s², signed)
elements.justification: kin.accel_longitudinal: 'acceleration along heading, signed', 'Not a stand-in for: speed'; a value below the negative tolerance is a falling forward speed.

elements.span: while a is not backing (drv.motion.backing with the speed tolerance does not hold)
elements.justification: drv.motion.backing tells a rearward motion, for which the sign of the acceleration along the heading means the opposite.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: A vehicle moving forward brakes; its longitudinal acceleration is below the negative tolerance.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: A vehicle moves forward at constant speed with its brake lamp lit.
